consent.title: Olukusa Lwo
consent.paragraph1: Oyitiddwa okumaliriza okwekenneenya okw'okwetegekera emirimu ng'oyita mu MeritLense. Okwetaba kwa kyeyagalire, era bw'oweeyongerayo okakasa nti olonze okwetaba ku lulwo.
consent.paragraph2: Okuddamu kwo, eddoboozi lyo n'ebikwata ku kukakasa endagamuntu yo bijja kukozesebwa okukola okwekenneenya kuno, era alipoota evaamu ejja kugabanibwa n'omukozesa oba ekitongole ekyagisaba. MeritLense si y'esalawo ku kukozesa — omukozesa y'asalawo.
consent.namePlaceholder: Erinnya lyo terisangiddwa — tukusaba okutuukirira ttiimu y'obuyambi
consent.agreeLabel: Nzikiriza okwetaba mu kwekenneenya kuno n'ebikwata ku nze okukozesebwa nga bwe kinnyonnyoddwa waggulu.
consent.errorGeneric: Wabaddewo ensobi mu kutereka olukusa lwo. Tukusaba oddemu ogezeeko.

privacy.title: Ekirango ky'Ebyama
privacy.paragraph1: MeritLense ekuŋŋaanya n'ekozesa okuddamu kwo okw'eddoboozi n'/oba okw'okuwandiika (nga mw'otwalidde eddoboozi erikwatiddwa n'ebiwandiiko byalyo bw'oddamu mu ddoboozi), ekifaananyi ekikubibwa okukakasa endagamuntu, n'obubonero, ebiraga n'ebivaamu ebirala okwekenneenya kwaffe okuyambibwako AI kwe kukola okuva mu kuddamu kwo. Singa olukiiko lwo lulimu okubuuzibwa kwa vidiyo okw'obutereevu, akayimba kennyini tekakwatibwa — okuddamu kwo okw'eddoboozi kwokka kwe kuwandiikibwa okw'okwekenneenya.
privacy.paragraph2: Ebikwata ku ggwe bino bikozesebwa okukakasa endagamuntu yo, okukola okwekenneenya kwo okw'okwetegekera emirimu, okwekenneenya okuddamu kwo n'obusobozi bwo, n'okukola alipoota y'okwekenneenya kwo era, bwe kiba kisaanidde, satifikeeti.
privacy.paragraph3: Ebitundu ebimu eby'okwekenneenya kuno bikozesa AI n'okwekenneenya okwekola kwokka okuwandiika, okuvvuunula n'okwekenneenya okuddamu kwo. Ebivaamu bye bimanyisa ebiyamba okusalawo, si kye kusalawo okusembayo — omukozesa oba ekitongole ekyakuyita mu kwekenneenya kuno kye kivunaanyizibwa mu bujjuvu ku kusalawo kwonna okw'okukozesa.
privacy.paragraph4: MeritLense tetunda bikwata ku ggwe. Abaweereza b'obuweereza abakkirizibwa (okugeza abakyusa eddoboozi mu biwandiiko, abavvuunuzi n'abeekenneenya aba AI) basobola okukozesa ebikwata ku ggwe ku kigero ekyetaagisa kyokka okuwa obuweereza buno obw'okwekenneenya, nga bakuuma bulungi ebikwata ku ggwe. Ebivaamu byo era bigabanibwa n'omukozesa oba ekitongole ekyasaba okwekenneenya kuno.
privacy.paragraph5: Ebikwata ku ggwe bikuumibwa okusinziira ku nkola ya MeritLense ey'okukuuma ebikwata ku bantu.
privacy.ackLabel: Nkakasa nti nsomye era ntegedde Ekirango kino eky'Ebyama era nzikiriza nti ebikwata ku nze, nga mw'otwalidde vidiyo, eddoboozi, ebiwandiiko n'ebikwata ku kukakasa endagamuntu, bijja kukozesebwa olw'ebigendererwa ebinnyonnyoddwa waggulu.
privacy.errorGeneric: Wabaddewo ensobi mu kutereka okukkiriza kwo. Tukusaba oddemu ogezeeko.

identity.unavailableParagraph1: Tetusanze kifaananyi ekisomeka mu fayiro ky'olukiiko luno.
identity.unavailableParagraph2: Tukusaba otuukirire omuntu eyakuyita mu kubuuzibwa kuno — olukiiko lwo terusobola kweyongerayo okutuusa kino lwe kinaagonjoolwa.
identity.setupFailedBody: Kino kitera kuba kizibu kya kakwate eky'akaseera. Tukusaba okebere yintaneeti yo oddemu ogezeeko.
identity.title: Kakasa endagamuntu yo
identity.subtitle: Kuba ekifaananyi mangu tukakase nti ggwe. Tojja kusobola kutandika kubuuzibwa okutuusa kino lwe kinaatuuka.
identity.cameraError: Tetusobodde kufuna kkamera yo. Tukusaba okkirize kkamera oddemu ogezeeko.
identity.noFaceMessage: Tetuzudde maaso galabika bulungi mu kifaananyi ekyo — kino si kivaamu kya kugeraageranya, tetusobodde busobozi kwekenneenya kifaananyi.
identity.multipleFacesMessage: Wazuuliddwa abantu abasukka omu. Tukusaba okakase nti ggwe wekka alabika, oddemu ogezeeko.
tips: Tunuulira ekitangaala — weewale okutuula ng'eddirisa oba ettaala biri emabega wo
Tunuulira kkamera butereevu ng'amaaso go gonna galabika
Ggyako gaalubindi z'enjuba oba ekintu kyonna ekibisse amaaso go
Kakasa nti ggwe wekka ali mu kifaananyi

steps.title: Nga tonnatandika
steps.description: Okulaba amangu engeri okubuuzibwa kuno gye kukolamu — kitwala sikonda nga 20.

steps.title: Soma oba wuliriza buli kibuuzo
steps.description: Buli kibuuzo kiragibwa ku ssirini — nyiga akabonero ka sipiika bw'oba oyagala kikusomerwe.

steps.title: Ddamu mu ddoboozi oba ng'owandiika
steps.description: Londa ekikwanguyira — osobola okukyusa wakati w'okukwata n'okuwandiika ku kibuuzo kyonna.

steps.title: Faayo ku ssaawa
steps.description: Obudde obusigaddeyo bulabika bulijjo waggulu ku lupapula — okubuuzibwa kweweereza kwokka obudde bwe buggwaawo.

steps.title: Oli mwetegefu
steps.description: Ddamu mu sipiidi yo mu budde obuweereddwa. Omukisa omulungi!

cookie.title: Tussaamu ekitiibwa ku byama byo
cookie.body: Tukozesa cookies ezeetaagisa n'okutereka okufaanana bwe tutyo okukukuuma ng'oli muyingize n'omukutu okukola. Ng'otukkirizza, twandikozesezza ne cookies ez'okwesalirawo ez'okwekenneenya n'ez'okutunda; leero tewali n'emu ekola. Osobola okukyusa by'olonze essaawa yonna mu Nteekateeka za cookies wansi ku lupapula.
cookie.necessaryDescription: Zeetaagisa okuyingira, okusigala ng'oli muyingize, okujjukira olulimi lwo n'okukuuma omukutu nga gwa bukuumi.
cookie.analyticsDescription: Zandituyambye okutegeera engeri omukutu gye gukozesebwamu tusobole okugulongoosa.
cookie.marketingDescription: Zanditusobozesezza okupima kampeyini zaffe n'okulaga ebikwatagana mu bifo ebirala.

howItWorks: Ebibuuzo biva mu tterekero lyaffe ery'ebibuuzo ebikkiriziddwa (Olungereza n'Oluwarabu).
Osobola okuwuliriza ekibuuzo mu nnimi zombi.
Osobola okuddamu mu ddoboozi oba mu biwandiiko, okusinziira ku buyambi bw'olulimi.
language.audioSupportBody: Eddoboozi liriwo mu Lungereza ne mu nnimi ezisinga ezikkiriziddwa. Eddoboozi bwe libeera teririiwo mu lulimi lwo, osobola okusoma ekibuuzo n'oddamu ng'owandiika.
